question: What kind of warranty coverage do you offer on safety nets in Chennai?
answer:
At GCM Netting Solutions, we stand behind the quality and durability of our safety nets in Chennai. We offer a comprehensive warranty ranging from 3 to 5 years on our installed safety nets. This warranty covers manufacturing defects and premature degradation of the net material under normal usage conditions. Our safety nets are constructed from high-density polyethylene (HDPE) material and are UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Chennai climate, ensuring long-lasting protection.

The warranty is valid from the date of professional installation by our experienced GCM Netting Solutions team. It's important to note that the warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, alterations, or acts of nature beyond normal wear and tear. If you experience any issues covered under the warranty, simply contact us at +91 99123 99224, and we will promptly assess the situation and provide the necessary repairs or replacements. We are committed to ensuring your complete satisfaction with our safety nets installation services in Chennai and providing you with reliable fall protection for years to come.
